slices.focus: A low-key Gulf Coast anniversary trip shows Ariana and Devon their relationship has real stability
slices.summary: Ariana and Devon take a quiet Gulf Coast overnight for their anniversary and realize their relationship feels spacious and solid after years of boundary work. They plan a monthly overnight and one weekly off-limits block to protect the newfound steadiness.
open_loops: Establishing one monthly overnight as an anchor ritual
Maintaining one weekly off-limits block for protected time
Watching for small signs of the steadier baseline in ordinary days
